entity_raw.definition_raw: Your blood courses with power, granting you greater spell-like abilities.   Prerequisites: Able to use drow spell-like abilities, drow. Benefit: You may use detect magic as a spell-like ability at will, and add feather fall and levitate to the spell-like abilities that you may use once each per day. Your caster level is equal to your character level.
